name: Sales Rep Activity
query:
SELECT
  ur.user AS `Sales Rep:Link/User:220`,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabKC Visit` v WHERE v.sales_rep = ur.user) AS `Visits:Int:90`,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabKC Task` t WHERE t.owner_rep = ur.user
     AND t.status IN ('Open', 'In Progress')) AS `Open Tasks:Int:110`,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabKC Task` t WHERE t.owner_rep = ur.user
     AND t.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled') AND t.due_date < CURDATE()) AS `Overdue Tasks:Int:120`,
  (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.estimated_annual_revenue_usd), 0) FROM `tabKC Opportunity` o
     WHERE o.sales_rep = ur.user AND o.opportunity_stage NOT IN ('Won', 'Lost')) AS `Pipeline USD:Currency:150`
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT parent AS user FROM `tabHas Role`
      WHERE role = 'Sales Rep' AND parenttype = 'User') ur
JOIN `tabUser` u ON u.name = ur.user AND u.enabled = 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
